name: node_similarity
author: eaf1d77a
description: Measures how similar two nodes' connections are: the number of common neighbours they share and their Jaccard similarity (shared neighbours divided by all distinct neighbours, from 0 = nothing in common to 1 = identical neighbourhoods). Use for questions like 'How similar are Alice's and Bob's connections?', 'Do these two airports serve the same destinations?' or, with only node_a, 'Which nodes are most similar to Alice?'. Give node_a and node_b to compare one pair; give only node_a to get the top_k most similar nodes ranked by Jaccard score. Works on directed and undirected graphs (direction picks out-, in- or all neighbours on directed graphs). Returns node ids with labels, the common-neighbour count, the Jaccard score and the shared neighbours. Node ids must be exact: use lookup_node first to turn a name into an id.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse

node_a.description: ID of the first node (use lookup_node to find it from a name)

node_b.description: ID of the second node. Leave out to rank the nodes most similar to node_a

direction.description: On directed graphs, compare outgoing neighbours ('out'), incoming neighbours ('in') or all neighbours ('any'). Ignored on undirected graphs

top_k.description: Ranking mode: how many similar nodes to return. Pair mode: how many shared neighbours to list
